title: Lightning HA
description: Lightning's database cluster from inside: who is primary, is the replica keeping up, is etcd healthy, do both APIs reach the database, and did every scheduled job run.

panels.title: Primary
panels.description: The Patroni member holding the leader lock; its database takes the writes.

panels.title: Timeline
panels.description: Goes up by one at every failover.

panels.title: etcd members up
panels.description: As seen by the best-connected member, itself included.

panels.title: Failed jobs
panels.description: Timer-driven jobs whose last run failed on some node.

panels.title: Last good backup
panels.description: Age of the last successful lightning-backup run. BackupStale warns past 26 hours.

panels.title: Replica lag
panels.description: Time since the replica last replayed a transaction that the primary has committed.

panels.title: Replica behind, in WAL
panels.description: Bytes of WAL the primary has written that each standby has not replayed.

panels.title: WAL held by replication slots
panels.description: An inactive slot keeps WAL forever; this climbing means disk will follow.

targets.expr: sum by (state) (pg_stat_activity_count{job="postgres", datname="lightningapi"} and on (host) pg_replication_is_replica{job="postgres"} == 0)

panels.title: Longest transaction
panels.description: Long transactions hold back vacuum and replication; minutes is a smell.

panels.title: Temp files written
panels.description: Queries spilling to disk because work_mem is too small for them.

panels.title: Checkpoints
panels.description: Per hour. Many requested checkpoints mean max_wal_size is small for the write load.

panels.title: WAL fsync, p99
panels.description: etcd waits for this on every write. Over 100 ms pages; the witness warns over 25 ms.

panels.title: Leader changes
panels.description: EtcdLeaderChurn warns over 3 in an hour.

panels.title: HAProxy: each API's road to the database
Backend each node's HAProxy sends to
panels.description: HAProxy health-checks Patroni's /leader, so exactly one server per node should be UP.

panels.title: Jobs
panels.description: One row per job per node. A job runs on whichever node holds its role; JobMissedRun and BackupStale look at the latest success across nodes.

panels.title: Average write latency
panels.description: This card has stalled for up to 907 ms under load; a rising line is the time to replace it.

panels.title: WireGuard handshakes
panels.description: wg0 is the Patroni and etcd mesh; wg-mon is the command center's own. Over 3 minutes means the peer is gone.
